name: poetic-line-zine-poster
title_zh: 把一张照片变成杂志级诗性海报
tagline_zh: 人像、街景、猫狗、建筑都行——保留原图，用炭笔扫出关系、一抹结构色线稿，再压上克制英文排版，输出你要的精确比例。
tagline_en: Portrait, street, pet, building—keep the photo, sweep its relationships into charcoal, add one structural.
desc_en: Create a clean vertical photo-and-abstraction editorial artwork from an uploaded portrait, travel photo, animal, plant, architecture, object, or scene. Preserve the source photo, distill its relationships into broad charcoal sweeps and one structural chromatic scribble, add restrained experimental English typography, and deliver an exact requested aspect ratio through deterministic composition and
why_zh: 不是滤镜叠加，是先把照片拆成关系再重画：炭笔负责氛围、单色线稿负责结构，排版只做衬线。
why_en: Not a filter stack—it decomposes the photo into relationships, redraws with charcoal for mood and one scribble for structure.
limit_zh: 只接受单张上传图，且需主体清晰、背景不过曝；英文排版仅限衬线字体，不做中文；输出为静态PNG，不生成多页或动效。
limit_en: Single clear-subject photo only, no blown highlights; serif English type only, no Chinese; static PNG output, no multipage or motion; deterministic.
title_en: Turn one photo into a poetic editorial poster
